title: spec(security): `tenancy-posture.ts` still calls the Apache-2.0 `@objectstack/organizations` runtime "enterprise" (file header + `postureStampsOrganization` docblock)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location: a published `@objectstack/spec` docblock labels open code "enterprise". Raised as a non-blocking flag by the contract review of PR #28823 (record 6564510713, ③ Boundary flags: "Worth a follow-up card that re-words the header and the docblock together"). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:spec`, prose only in `packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): #16718 and #17379 (closed) swept the "enterprise / closed-source" spellings of `@objectstack/organizations` after ADR-0132; this file's header and docblock were not reached. #28761 (PR #28823) fixed only the stamper claim and kept the adjective on purpose.
reach: authors and agents who read the posture docblocks and conclude that stamping or the posture runtime is closed code.

## Where

`packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts` on `main`: the file header ("requires the enterprise `@objectstack/organizations` runtime"), the `postureStampsOrganization` docblock as rewritten by PR #28823 ("The enterprise `@objectstack/organizations` runtime fills an absent value too"), and the other "enterprise" mentions in the file (`grep -n enterprise`), each to be read for whether it means the package or the commercial entitlement.

## What is true

Since ADR-0132 D1, `@objectstack/organizations` ships from this repo as `packages/plugins/organizations` (Apache-2.0). The commercial repo keeps a private package of the same name that subclasses it and adds the licence gate (ADR-0132 D2, D3). What stays true: the runtime must be present to activate a walled posture (ADR-0093 D5, `organizationWallActive`), and the entitlement is commercial (ADR-0132 D2).

## Done when

The header and the docblocks name the package without the "enterprise" adjective, and say "commercial entitlement" where they mean the licence. No behaviour change; spec patch changeset.
